title: Adrenal anatomy, embryology and blood supply
guide: Gland = 80% cortex/20% medulla on the kidney. Embryology: 6 wks urogenital ridge (mesoderm) → adrenal primordium (coelomic epithelium); 8 wks hormone synthesis; 9–10 wks urine formation; 12 wks development complete; kidney complete 32–36 wks; fetal:adult ratio 4:1; TFs SF-1, DAX1 (orphans), WNT4. Arteries: superior (inferior phrenic), middle (aorta), inferior (renal). Veins: right → IVC; left → left renal vein → IVC.

title: Relations, fetal zone and the definitive zones
guide: Right anterior IVC + right liver lobe, posterior right crus; left anterior stomach/pancreas/spleen, posterior left crus. Fetal zone: DHEAS principal, regresses after birth. Definitive: ZG (at birth, RAAS, 15%, aldosterone), ZF (at birth, pituitary, 75%, cortisol, lipid-rich clear cells), ZR (by 2–3 y, pituitary, 10%, DHEAS >20 mg/day; adrenarche 6–8 y, regresses post-reproductive).

title: Steroidogenesis: the enzyme ladder and zone specificity
guide: Cholesterol (LDL) → pregnenolone via StAR (steroid acute regulatory protein; rate-limiting; defect → congenital lipid hyperplasia). 17α-hydroxylase on both Δ pairs; 17,20 lyase → DHEA; 3β-HSD → progesterone; 21α-hydroxylase → DOC/11-deoxycortisol; 11β-hydroxylase → corticosterone/cortisol; 18-hydroxylase then aldosterone synthase (only in ZG) → aldosterone. Gonadal: 17β-HSD3 → testosterone/estradiol; 5α-reductase II → DHT (testis); aromatase (POR = P450 oxidoreductase) → estrone (ovary).

title: 11β-HSD2 defects: AME and licorice
guide: 11β-HSD2 normally converts cortisol → cortisone. Inherited defect = AME; acquired inhibition by Cushing's disease and licorice excess. Excess cortisol acts as mineralocorticoid → salt + water retention → HTN with alkalosis and hypokalaemia.
